name: The Herbig Family Tree
title: The Goodwin Tree (Herbig Family Tree)
description: A massive hollowed-out red gum in Springton where German pioneer Friedrich Herbig lived with his wife and young family in the 1850s. Dual Adelaide Crows premiership captain and 2021 Melbourne premiership coach Simon Goodwin is a direct descendant of Friedrich Herbig.

name: The Ramsgate Hotel
title: The 2002 Ramsgate Rumble
description: Ground zero for Showdown folklore. The Sunday night after Showdown XI in April 2002—an eight-point Port Adelaide win—banter between Port's Josh Carr and Crows players (including Kane Johnson and captain Mark Ricciuto) spilled outside onto Seaview Road, ending with Ricciuto throwing Carr over the bonnet of a parked car before players scattered at the sound of approaching sirens.
